view: sasspile async compile pipeline (Shared stream core)
question: How does Sass source text move stage-by-stage to CSS, and where do owned values/accumulators flow through rxrust operators?
generatedFrom: source over crates/sasspile/src (post Shared-stream cutover, tasks 3.1)

nodes.label: async compile(content)
nodes.description: Public async entry; builds and drives the Shared observable chain, terminating in into_future().await. No sync compile_string / block_on facade.

nodes.label: lex (inlined in compile)
nodes.description: compile inlines lexing as operators on ONE Shared chain: Shared::from_iter(chars) -> scan_map(LexAcc) -> flat_map(Shared::from_iter) -> collect::<Vec<Tok>>. The separate lexer::token_stream() (chars->from_iter->scan_map->flat_map->box_it Local observable) is now only a helper used by lexer tests, NOT the compile pipeline.

nodes.label: LexAcc (owned accumulator)
nodes.description: DFA state moved through scan_map: buf/hash/var/interp depth stack/out/slash/block. Interp depth is data, not recursion.

nodes.label: collect + into_future (tokens)
nodes.description: collect::<Vec<Tok>>() (the single Vec boundary inside the one Shared chain) feeding the parser; not a separate boxed sub-observable bridged by std.

nodes.label: structure::Block::parse
nodes.description: Recursive-descent over the token slice produces an owned Block tree (DATA). No mutable driving accumulator; recursion only to build nested owned data.

nodes.label: Block / Decl
nodes.description: Block { head:Vec<Tok>, decls:Vec<(Vec<Tok>,Vec<Tok>)>, body:Vec<Block>, order:u32 } — owned nested structure; body/decls use 'body' (not 'children').

nodes.label: Shared::from_stream(root.body)
nodes.description: ONE cold Shared observable over the top-level items; a single from_stream task polls sequentially, preserving document order.

nodes.label: scan_map((env, taken))
nodes.description: Owned accumulator (global Env, @if-chain 'taken' bool) moved across siblings; each block evaluated independently, returns Vec<Leaf>; the taken value threads the branch chain as a moved value (no mutable chain_taken flag).

nodes.label: eval::eval_top/eval_block/eval_list/eval_each
nodes.description: Pure per-block evaluation (owned Block + prefix + &Env -> owned Vec<Leaf>). Nesting = recursion over owned data; @each = flat_map over item stream; @if/@else = immutable taken value.

nodes.label: flat_map(Shared::from_iter)
nodes.description: Flattens each item's Vec<Leaf> into the main stream inline and in order (from_iter is non-timed, runs synchronously) — order-preserving fan-out.

nodes.label: Leaf
nodes.description: Resolved flat output rule: selector:String + decls:Vec<(String,String)>. Interpolation/vars resolved during eval.

nodes.label: map(leaf_block)
nodes.description: Pure per-leaf map: Leaf -> CSS block String.

nodes.label: reduce_initial + into_future().await
nodes.description: Merge chunks into one String; terminal into_future().await (Empty -> Ok("")). No std mpsc/recv, no block_on facade — the reactive chain terminates via rxrust's own terminal.

nodes.label: Expr / Expr::render/eval
nodes.description: Token run folds ONCE into Expr (Lit/Var/Interp/Concat/Bin/Cmp/And/Or/If/Func); eval resolves against owned Env; undefined $var inside #{} is Err (drops decl); builtin calls via whitelist.

nodes.label: Value / to_css
nodes.description: Owned value model flowing down the stream; CSS produced lazily by to_css only when demanded.

nodes.label: Env = HashMap<String,Value>
nodes.description: Variable environment; the global Env is seeded by eval::global_env and carried as the scan_map accumulator's owned value; per-block child Env is produced by apply_decls (owned, moved down).

edges.description: starts the single Shared chain by inlining lexing over owned chars
token stream is collected to owned Vec<Tok> within the one chain
per item, scan_map threads owned (env, taken)
eval_top evaluates one block independently -> Vec<Leaf>

gaps.note: Document order is preserved today by ONE ordered from_stream + inline flat_map(from_iter); the concurrent fan-out + order-key/stable-sort path (design D3) is deferred to the independent-subgraph (@use/module) stage.
